WhatsApp Link Generator

Generate a WhatsApp click-to-chat wa.me link with an international number and optional pre-filled message — no contact save needed.

Open chat

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the phone number in international format (country code + number, digits only).
  2. Type an optional pre-filled message.
  3. Copy the wa.me link or click Open chat to test it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is wa.me an official WhatsApp link?

Yes — wa.me is WhatsApp's official click-to-chat domain. The link opens a chat with that number even if it is not in your contacts.

What number format does it need?

Enter the full international number: country code + number, digits only, no +, spaces or dashes.

Can the pre-filled message include emojis?

The message is percent-encoded with encodeURIComponent, so emojis, line breaks and special characters all work.

Is this private?

Fully — the link is built locally in your browser.
